messages.author: e462f69252f08a3d
messages.subject: Installing in the new computer.
parts:
Good afternoon everyone,

I'm having problems installing INLA, the following message appears:

*** moving datasets to lazyload DB
Warning: file ‘Epil.rda’ has magic number 'RDX3'
  Use of save versions prior to 2 is deprecated
Error : bad restore file magic number (file may be corrupted) -- no data loaded
ERROR: lazydata failed for package ‘INLA’
* removing ‘/mnt/nfs/home/fabiano_coelho/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.3/INLA’
* restoring previous ‘/mnt/nfs/home/fabiano_coelho/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.3/INLA’
Error in readRDS(pfile) :
  cannot read workspace version 3 written by R 3.6.3; need R 3.5.0 or newer
* removing ‘/mnt/nfs/home/fabiano_coelho/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.3/roxygen2’
Error in readRDS(pfile) :
  cannot read workspace version 3 written by R 3.6.3; need R 3.5.0 or newer
* removing ‘/mnt/nfs/home/fabiano_coelho/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.3/rversions’
Error in readRDS(pfile) :
  cannot read workspace version 3 written by R 3.6.3; need R 3.5.0 or newer
* removing ‘/mnt/nfs/home/fabiano_coelho/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.3/sf’
ERROR: dependencies ‘roxygen2’, ‘rversions’ are not available for package ‘devtools’
* removing ‘/mnt/nfs/home/fabiano_coelho/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.3/devtools’
ERROR: dependency ‘sf’ is not available for package ‘spdep’
* removing ‘/mnt/nfs/home/fabiano_coelho/R/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu-library/3.3/spdep’

The downloaded source packages are in
        ‘/tmp/Rtmp07qA7E/downloaded_packages’

Warning messages:
1: In install.packages("INLA", repos = c(getOption("repos"),  ... :
  installation of package ‘xml2’ had non-zero exit status
2: In install.packages("INLA", repos = c(getOption("repos"),  ... :
  installation of package ‘units’ had non-zero exit status
3: In install.packages("INLA", repos = c(getOption("repos"),  ... :
  installation of package ‘HKprocess’ had non-zero exit status
4: In install.packages("INLA", repos = c(getOption("repos"),  ... :
  installation of package ‘rgeos’ had non-zero exit status
5: In install.packages("INLA", repos = c(getOption("repos"),  ... :
  installation of package ‘rgl’ had non-zero exit status
6: In install.packages("INLA", repos = c(getOption("repos"),  ... :
  installation of package ‘INLA’ had non-zero exit status
7: In install.packages("INLA", repos = c(getOption("repos"),  ... :
  installation of package ‘roxygen2’ had non-zero exit status
8: In install.packages("INLA", repos = c(getOption("repos"),  ... :
  installation of package ‘rversions’ had non-zero exit status
9: In install.packages("INLA", repos = c(getOption("repos"),  ... :
  installation of package ‘sf’ had non-zero exit status
10: In install.packages("INLA", repos = c(getOption("repos"),  ... :
  installation of package ‘devtools’ had non-zero exit status
11: In install.packages("INLA", repos = c(getOption("repos"),  ... :
  installation of package ‘spdep’ had non-zero exit status


As I understand it, there is an incompatibility problem with R. versions. Is there any other problem that you can identify by looking at the error message above?

Thank you for your attention.

messages.author: afb003e064114795
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Installing in the new computer.
parts:
Version 3.3 is very old, and you would need an old version of the INLA package to use it.
At the moment, version 3.6.3 would be recommended (version 4.0 does not yet work).

Finn
